big_case.notes: The Solicitor General sought review of a D.C. Circuit judgment holding unlawful Presidential Proclamation 10,888 and its guidance, which suspend entry at the southern border and cut off access to asylum, with classwide relief. The Court granted on the merits question and on whether 8 U.S.C. 1252(f)(1) bars the classwide relief. Twenty-two States and three other amici supported the petition at the cert stage. Nationwide reach, a core executive-power question and a recurring remedial question put this near the top of the Term's docket.
